scenarios.name: Master of Death entering surveils 2 and both cards can go to the graveyard
scenarios.ruling: Surveil 2 looks at the top two cards and puts any number of them into the graveyard; here both are binned, so the library shrinks by two.

scenarios.name: Paying 1 life at upkeep returns Master of Death from your graveyard to your hand
scenarios.ruling: The ability functions from the graveyard; paying 1 life on resolution returns the card to your hand.

scenarios.name: Declining to pay 1 life leaves Master of Death in your graveyard
scenarios.ruling: The payment is optional; if you do not pay, the card is not returned and you lose no life.

scenarios.name: The upkeep ability does not trigger while Master of Death is on the battlefield
scenarios.ruling: The intervening-if clause checks that the card is in your graveyard; a Master of Death on the battlefield never triggers it.
